name: handkerchief-vita
description: Unofficial PS Vita port of the PC game Handkerchief (1999-2000) by full static recompilation. Bring your own game files.
long_description: An unofficial, non-commercial port of the Windows game *Handkerchief* (OPUS Corp. / ASK Co., Ltd., 1999-2000) to the PlayStation Vita. The original executable is statically recompiled from x86 to C, so the game's own code runs unchanged; the port supplies the Windows environment it expects. **You need your own copy of the game.
